description: Extremely rare artifact, guarded by the azure dragons.
trivia: Skaði (Skadi) is the Goddess of Winter in Norse mythology.
Skaði (Skadi) means "damage" or "harm" in Old Norse and Icelandic, pronounced "Skathi".
Þjazi (Thiazi), Skadi's father in Norse mythology, had his eyes placed in the night sky as stars.
recommendedFor: Normally reliant on the Slow provided by Diffusal Blade, Eye of Skadi offers a strong constant slow for the late game

Mana Shield reduces damage by 98%, but only as long as Medusa has mana to fuel the ability. With the item's large amount of both HP and Mana, Eye of skadi offers the most effective HP to Medusa in a single item. Additionally, the slow is helpful for keeping enemy heroes at a distance during fights
